name: Aluminium Fluoride (AlF3): Smelter Flux Import Substitution from Fertiliser Fluorine By-Product
scope: India's aluminium fluoride (AlF3) supply chain: the smelter build-out driving flux demand, the fertiliser FSA by-product route, and listed makers, entrants and smelter buyers.

summary.one_line: Results week for the theme. Paradeep Phosphates reports Q2 FY27 on 29 Oct, NALCO's AlF3 EoI closes 30 Oct and NALCO reports on 2 Nov. BALCO's new smelter has reached 50% of its 435 kt expansion, and Alufluoride sits about 20% below its high with Q2 results still not scheduled.
key_points: This week: Paradeep Phosphates' board meets on 29 Oct 2026 to approve Q2/H1 FY27 results (S14). These are the first numbers since the Rs 250 cr, 15,000 tpa AlF3 plant was approved on 28 Jul, and they may show engineering or ordering progress (S1)(S2).

This week: on 22 Oct, Paradeep signed a Rs 4,750 cr MoU with Odisha for a chemical plant and a bio-fertiliser unit. Reports give no capex split and no timeline, and do not mention AlF3 (S24). The stock closed at Rs 133.57 on 23 Oct, down 3.46% (S24). We do not count the MoU as an AlF3 catalyst.

NALCO's AlF3 JV/partner EoI (ref. NALCO/BD/ST/2026/5805) closes on 30 Oct 2026 after an extension from 12 Oct. No respondents have been disclosed (S21)(S23). NALCO's board meets on 2 Nov to approve Q2 FY27 results and consider an interim dividend, according to PSU Connect (S18).

Demand is arriving. BALCO commissioned the second zone of its 525 kA potline, taking operating capacity to 50% of its planned 435 kt expansion. BALCO produced 178 kt in Q2 FY27, up 19% year on year (S20). At 14-20 kg of AlF3 per tonne (S3), the full 435 kt implies about 6-9 kt/yr of extra AlF3 (our arithmetic).

Announced smelter additions total about 1.3 Mtpa: Hindalco Aditya +3.6 lakh tpa (Rs 21,000 cr) (S6), NALCO Angul +0.5 Mtpa by early 2030 (S7)(S8) and BALCO +435 kt (S20). That implies roughly 18-26 kt/yr of extra AlF3 (our arithmetic on S3). Announced domestic supply additions are 6 kt at Alufluoride and 15 kt at Paradeep (S1)(S3).

China's benchmark AlF3 contracts for October settled more than 1,000 yuan/t higher, at 12,600-13,000 yuan/t (SMM, 22 Oct). That compares with 11,500-12,500 on 24 Sep. The rise is driven by fluorite costs and low operating rates (S16)(S22). We found no newer SMM weekly review.

Alufluoride (24,000 tpa since Jun 2026) saw Q1 FY27 sales fall to Rs 26.6 cr from Rs 43.8 cr on the FSA shortage (S3)(S4). It closed at Rs 544 on 28 Oct, giving a market cap of Rs 430 cr and a P/E of 17.3 (S4). It is 20.4% below its 52-week high on screener data as of 26 Oct (S4). No Q2 board-meeting date had been filed as of 28 Oct (S4).

FSA, not plant capacity, remains the bottleneck. Paradeep cited the Hormuz disruption to sulphur and ammonia and ran about 70% of phosphoric capacity in Q1 (S1). Alufluoride cut operations in May 2026 for the same reason (S5).

for_investors.title: Who benefits
points: Alufluoride is the only qualified listed pure-play, supplying Hindalco, Vedanta and NALCO (S4) from 24,000 tpa of capacity (S3). BALCO's ramp (S20) and firmer Chinese prices (S22) help, but volumes depend on FSA.
Paradeep Phosphates converts 9,000-10,000 tpa of low-value FSA into a non-subsidy product (S1). Strategically useful, but under 1% of TTM sales of Rs 23,447 cr (S14).
NALCO and other smelters: a domestic JV or long-term partner would cut reliance on imported AlF3, such as the 2,520 t NALCO tendered for in Jan 2026 (S21).

for_investors.title: Who is hurt / risks
points: Alufluoride buys part of its FSA from Paradeep 'as available' (S3). Paradeep plans to use its own HFSA in-house (S1), so that source likely disappears around 2028.
FSA output depends on phosphoric acid run rates, which the 2026 Hormuz disruption to sulphur and ammonia has hit (S1)(S5).
Customer concentration: Alufluoride's largest customer was 69.27% of its FY25 AlF3 revenue (S3).

for_investors.title: What to watch
points: 29 Oct: Paradeep Q2 FY27 results and any AlF3 project update (S14).
30 Oct: NALCO EoI closes. 2 Nov: NALCO Q2 FY27 board meeting (S18)(S21). Watch for any shortlist or RFP.
Alufluoride Q2 FY27 results, not yet scheduled (S4). They will show whether volumes recovered, as management expected (S3).

sections.title: What AlF3 is and how the fertiliser by-product route works

subsections.title: The product, demand driver and price reference

blocks.text: Aluminium fluoride is added to the cryolite bath in aluminium electrolysis to lower its melting point and increase conductivity (S10). Alufluoride says 14-20 kg of AlF3 is used per tonne of aluminium. It describes the Indian market as supplied by fewer than five domestic makers plus imports, with only a few able to supply high-purity, low-bulk-density material to the major smelters (S3). AlF3 is a consumable whose volume rises in line with primary aluminium output.

Import data is thin. OEC data for 2022 lists India as the world's second-largest importer of aluminium fluoride, at about USD 82.3 mn (S19). NALCO's Jan 2026 global tender for 2,520 t of low-bulk-density AlF3 is a recent sign of import reliance (S21). A search this week again found no official 2025-26 import volume and no DGTR anti-dumping case or duty change on AlF3 (HS 28261200).

blocks.caption: China AlF3 reference prices (SMM, yuan/t)
rows: October contracts settled more than 1,000 yuan/t higher; tight spot supply

blocks.text: China's price rise is cost-driven, with fluorite firm and mine operating rates low (S22). It is not a demand boom. Firmer Chinese prices reduce the near-term threat from imports into India.

subsections.title: The FSA route and its bottleneck

blocks.text: In the wet route, aluminium hydroxide is reacted with hydrofluosilicic acid (FSA/HFSA), the silica is filtered out, and the AlF3 is crystallised and dried (S10). FSA is a by-product of phosphoric acid at phosphate fertiliser plants, so AlF3 supply depends on fertiliser operating rates (S3)(S5).

items: Paradeep Phosphates makes about 9,000-10,000 tpa of FSA and today sells all of it to outside parties (S1).

Alufluoride's FSA supply: an IFFCO Paradeep contract above 17,500 tpa (expandable to 19,000 tpa), about 4,500 tpa from Coromandel's Visakhapatnam and Kakinada plants, and Paradeep Phosphates 'as available' (S3).
In 2026, West Asia hostilities disrupted sulphur and ammonia supply through Hormuz. Alufluoride scaled back operations in May 2026 (S5), and Paradeep ran about 70% of phosphoric capacity (S1).

blocks.text: Vedanta Aluminium produced a record 649 kt in Q2 FY27, up 5% year on year. BALCO rose 19% to 178 kt, while Jharsuguda was flat at 470 kt (S20). BALCO is therefore where new AlF3 demand is showing up first.

subsections.title: Domestic AlF3 supply additions and NALCO's EoI

blocks.caption: Announced Indian AlF3 capacity moves
rows: New AlF3 plant at Paradeep, Rs 250 cr
JV / long-term partnership EoI for HBD and LBD AlF3 (plus CPC, coal-tar pitch)

blocks.text: NALCO's EoI seeks either an equity JV, preferably near the Angul smelter, or a long-term partnership tied to assured offtake. Responses feed a shortlist ahead of a detailed RFP or JV talks (S23). The issue date differs between sources: SMM gives 18 Sep (S21), while other reports give 21 Sep (S23). Specifications: HBD AlF3 of at least 90% purity and 1.3 g/cc bulk density, and LBD AlF3 of at least 95% and 0.75 g/cc, plus access to FSA or alumina hydrate (S9).

On paper, the new supply (+6 kt at Alufluoride, +15 kt at Paradeep) roughly matches the 18-26 kt of implied new demand. But both depend on FSA from the same few east-coast phosphoric acid plants (S1)(S3). Feedstock, not plant capacity, is the binding limit.

In FY25, Alufluoride produced a record 16,377 t and dispatched 15,831 t (S3). Q1 FY27 sales fell 39.3% year on year to Rs 26.6 cr on the FSA disruption. That leaves TTM sales at Rs 192 cr and PAT at Rs 25 cr, with ROCE of 24% and debt/equity of 0.36 (S4). Its shares were admitted to NSE trading on 17 Aug 2026 (S4). The largest customer was 69.27% of FY25 AlF3 revenue (S3). The Sep-2025 quarter, Rs 54.8 cr, is the comparison base for Q2 FY27 (S4).

SPIC makes 'Greenstar' ALF-96 AlF3 by the FSA-alumina hydrate route. Its named customers are Hindalco, Dubal, Stella and Foundry Service (S10). It does not disclose AlF3 capacity or revenue, and it is mainly a urea maker with TTM sales of Rs 3,024 cr (S11). Tanfac lists AlF3 among its HF-derived products (S12). Its Rs 495 cr expansion is mainly a Rs 405 cr, 20,000 t HFC-32 plant (S13). Neither company discloses AlF3 as a material earnings line.

Paradeep's guidance of Rs 180-200 cr revenue on 15,000 t implies about Rs 1.2-1.33 lakh/t (our arithmetic from S1). That is close to Alufluoride's FY25 blended revenue of about Rs 1.19 lakh per tonne dispatched (our arithmetic from S3 and S4). Management targets at least 20% of EBITDA from non-subsidy businesses over time (S1). The AlF3 plant is small next to Q1 FY27 revenue of Rs 6,124 cr and PAT of Rs 393 cr (S1)(S14). The new Rs 4,750 cr Odisha MoU covers a chemical plant and a bio-fertiliser unit, with no split or AlF3 reference disclosed (S24).

Coromandel supplies about 4,500 tpa of FSA to Alufluoride (S3) and has announced no AlF3 plant. Its market cap is about Rs 50,684 cr (S25). NALCO's market cap is about Rs 55,420 cr, with TTM PAT of Rs 6,751 cr (S15), so an AlF3 JV would be about supply security rather than earnings (S7)(S23).

sections.title: Research house views and market positioning

items: We again found no broker or mainstream media report grouping these stocks as an 'AlF3 theme'. Trade press (SMM, AlCircle) covers the NALCO EoI, and company news covers Paradeep's plant (S2)(S21)(S23).

Paradeep rose 14.54% intraday to Rs 159.50 on 29 Jul 2026 on Q1 results and the AlF3 approval (S2). It closed at Rs 138 on 28 Oct (S14), 26.0% below its 52-week high of Rs 181 on 26 Oct data (S14). The post-announcement gain has reversed.
Alufluoride closed at Rs 544 on 28 Oct against a 52-week high of Rs 701 (S4). It has drifted sideways this week (Rs 546 on 23 Oct last edition), with no news found and Q2 results pending.

On Paradeep's Q1 FY27 call, analysts from Elara Securities, Aequitas, HDFC AMC and others asked about AlF3 timing, realisation and grade. Management said the plant targets Odisha smelters and needs no qualification period (S1). This is management's view, not independently verified.

blocks.caption: Valuation snapshot (screener.in, numbers as of 26 Oct 2026)

items: FSA shortage: Alufluoride's Q1 FY27 sales fell 39% year on year when West Asia disruption cut feedstock (S4)(S5).
Supplier turning competitor: Paradeep supplies FSA to Alufluoride (S3) but plans to use its own HFSA in-house (S1).
Price: China's rise is cost-driven, on fluorite and low operating rates (S22). If fluorite eases, Chinese AlF3 and imports could get cheaper.
Concentration: Alufluoride's top customer was 69% of FY25 AlF3 revenue (S3), and demand is tied to three smelter groups (S4).

Project slippage: NALCO's earlier expansion plans were repeatedly delayed (S8). Its new smelter targets early 2030 (S7), and the AlF3 EoI deadline has already been extended once (S21). Hindalco has disclosed no Aditya commissioning date (S6).
Liquidity: Alufluoride's market cap is about Rs 430 cr (S4).

companies.name: Alufluoride Ltd
companies.role: India's largest maker of low-bulk-density AlF3, qualified at Hindalco, Vedanta and NALCO (S4). It converts fertiliser FSA into AlF3 at Visakhapatnam, with 24,000 tpa installed (S3).
companies.impact: The most direct play on smelter growth such as BALCO's ramp (S20) and on firmer China prices (S22), but FSA-constrained. Q1 FY27 sales were Rs 26.6 cr vs Rs 43.8 cr (S4). Q2 results are not yet scheduled (S4). A natural candidate for NALCO's EoI, though no respondents have been disclosed (S21).

companies.name: Southern Petrochemicals Industries Corporation (SPIC)
companies.role: Makes Greenstar ALF-96 AlF3 by the FSA route and supplies Hindalco, Dubal and others (S10). Mainly a urea maker (S11).
companies.impact: AlF3 capacity and revenue are undisclosed. Against TTM sales of Rs 3,024 cr (S11), it is unlikely to be a meaningful earnings driver on current evidence.

companies.name: Tanfac Industries Ltd
companies.role: HF-based fluorochemicals maker whose products include aluminium fluoride (S12).
companies.impact: Growth comes from HF and a Rs 405 cr HFC-32 plant (S13), not AlF3. The stock trades at about 104x earnings (S12), so the AlF3 theme is marginal for it.

companies.name: Paradeep Phosphates Ltd
companies.role: DAP/NPK maker producing 9,000-10,000 tpa of FSA. It is building a Rs 250 cr, 15,000 tpa AlF3 plant (S1)(S2).
companies.impact: Guided Rs 180-200 cr revenue and at least Rs 50 cr EBITDA after a 22-24 month build (S1). That is under 1% of TTM sales of Rs 23,447 cr (S14). Q2 results are due 29 Oct (S14). The new Rs 4,750 cr Odisha MoU does not mention AlF3 (S24).

companies.name: Coromandel International Ltd
companies.role: Supplies about 4,500 tpa of FSA to Alufluoride from its Visakhapatnam and Kakinada phosphoric acid plants (S3).
companies.impact: An FSA supplier only, with no AlF3 plant announced. At a market cap of about Rs 50,684 cr (S25), AlF3 would be immaterial.

companies.name: National Aluminium Company Ltd (NALCO)
companies.role: Smelter with 4.6 lakh t capacity (S8), adding 0.5 Mtpa at Angul by early 2030 (S7). It is seeking AlF3 JV or partnership proposals through an EoI closing 30 Oct 2026 (S21).
companies.impact: Supply security rather than earnings, given TTM PAT of Rs 6,751 cr (S15). Its Q2 board meeting on 2 Nov is the next disclosure point (S18).

companies.name: Hindalco Industries Ltd
companies.role: Buys AlF3 from Alufluoride and SPIC (S4)(S10). Adding a 3.6 lakh tpa smelter at Aditya (S6).
companies.impact: Implies about 5-7 kt/yr of extra AlF3 demand (our calc on S3, S6). No captive AlF3 plan or commissioning date found.

companies.name: Vedanta Ltd
companies.role: AlF3 customer of Alufluoride (S4). Its BALCO 435 kt expansion is 50% operational (S20).
companies.impact: The nearest-term demand addition. BALCO output rose 19% year on year to 178 kt in Q2 FY27 (S20), with full ramp targeted by Q4 FY27 (S17). No captive AlF3 plan found.

method: Weekly refresh of the 2026-W43 edition, researched on 28 Oct 2026 using web search and direct page fetches. New this week: (1) Paradeep's screener announcements page (S14), opened 28 Oct, shows a 29 Oct board meeting for Q2 FY27 results. It also lists a 23 Oct press release on a Rs 4,750 cr Odisha MoU; Angel One's report (S24) shows that MoU covers a chemical plant and a bio-fertiliser unit with no AlF3 reference. (2) AlCircle (S20) reports BALCO's Q2 FY27 output (178 kt, +19% YoY) and the 525 kA expansion at 50% of 435 kt. (3) PSU Connect (S18), seen in search results only because the site returns 403 to fetches, reports NALCO's 2 Nov board meeting. (4) Alufluoride's screener page (S4), opened 28 Oct, shows no Q2 board-meeting intimation yet. Dropped as stale: the Univest results-deadline preview, the MarketsMojo 9 Oct price page and the Outlook Business Vedanta capex piece. The last two were replaced by S4's 52-week high and S20. The valuation table uses numbers.json (screener.in, as of 26 Oct 2026). Closing prices quoted for 28 Oct come from the fetched screener pages S4 and S14. No newer SMM fluoride salt review than 22 Oct was found. Searches for a DGTR or customs action on AlF3 found none. Facts carried forward from company documents (S1, S3, S6, S10) are unchanged disclosures and were not re-fetched. Implied AlF3 demand and realisation figures are our own arithmetic and are labelled as such. Market-cap coverage: small caps (Alufluoride, SPIC), mid caps (Tanfac, Paradeep) and large caps (Coromandel, NALCO, Hindalco, Vedanta). Earlier searches for AlF3 plans at FACT, GSFC, Gujarat Fluorochemicals and Navin Fluorine found nothing qualifying, so the listed pure-play universe is effectively one small cap. Not verified: NALCO EoI respondents, AlF3 revenue shares for SPIC and Tanfac, Hindalco's Aditya commissioning date, 2025-26 India import volumes, and the brief's six-month and one-year return figures. No ratings or price targets.
